parsed.note_claim: The planes in the video are C-17 Globemasters operated by the US, not China, which does not have this aircraft and has not conducted airdrops to Gaza.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The C-17 Globemaster III is a large military transport plane used mainly by the United States and several allied countries, but not by China.
parsed.reason: The page directly states that the C-17 is operated by the US and not China, and separately confirms the footage shows a US aid airdrop and that there is no credible evidence of Chinese airdrops to Gaza.
